g.text: Why haven't you just... killed everyone, Roathe?
Dear me. Is that a real question, or a request?
You have the means. You have the strength. You've been vocal enough about your distaste for your situation.
I just don't understand why "The Devil of Tau" is content to sit in a crypt and twiddle his thumbs. Even with our deal.
You're Orokin. You clearly hate everyone around you. What's stopping you?
I just don't understand why "The Devil of Tau" is content to sit in a crypt and twiddle his thumbs. Especially since we don't have any kind of deal.
Pardon me while I take a moment to collect my thoughts before I begin this conversation from a place fueled entirely by rage and spite.
And I am pleased that you recognize that I have it within my grasp to turn this place into a slaughterhouse quite easily.
Because there is still the mystery of why I trusted you enough to tell you so very much, only to have you betray that trust, Usurper.
There is still work to be done, Usurper. I cannot very well have your assistance recovering all my memories if I go about murdering everyone in the vicinity, now can I?
As I am trying very hard not to immediately prove your point correct.
Because there is still the mystery of why I trusted you enough to tell you so very much, only to have you betray that trust, Usurper.
Perhaps I am hoping you will wisen up and change your mind. And the odds of that goes down dramatically if I have gone about slaughtering everyone in the vicinity, doesn't it?
But it would accomplish nothing to do so, now would it? If there is only one thing that you learn from war, it is that murder accomplishes shockingly little in the end.

And the odds of that goes down dramatically if I have gone about slaughtering everyone in the vicinity, doesn't it? If there is only one thing that you learn from war, it is that murder accomplishes shockingly little in the end.
Besides, it would accomplish nothing to do so, now would it? If there is only one thing that you learn from war, it is that murder accomplishes shockingly little in the end.
I am sympathetic toward your hatred toward the Orokin. Believe me. Most Orokin despised the Orokin. I am not unaware of our crimes. Of the travesties we committed.
As delightful as it might be to entertain the desire to commit a little of it from time to time.
As delightful as it might be to entertain the desire to commit a little of it from time to time.
The Yuvan theatre alone would be reason enough to burn our society to the ground. But you condemn a whole people - of which you were a product of, might I add, my Usurper - with one broad stroke!
So, the only reason you've let everyone live is because it'd be pointless to kill them?
There's no other reason you're letting everyone live?
You know nothing of all the kind souls who toiled and died within those golden walls. The sagas written of those lives that have been lost to time.
It would be pointless to kill them. Wouldn't it? Are you attempting to convince me otherwise? Usurper, I am impressed - I never figured you for such a devious monster!
If you are going to attempt to make some coy insinuation, Usurper, just come out and say it.
I am fairly certain if you came down to the crypt and found two bloody smears where the zealots used to stand, I would get quite the earful for it, don't you?
The rivers of tears that have been shed for the tragedies that will forever go unsung, simply because they go unknown to you.
It's okay to admit you're enjoying the company. People can do more than simply serve a utilitarian purpose.
It's okay to admit that we stave off the loneliness, even if we do annoy you.
From you, or the butler, or the Tenno, or the Tenno's terrifying "Mother." Ugh. That one. That one troubles me. A topic for another time.
I hear your child duplicate weep the name Adis.
Their name is unique to you.
Do not press your luck, Usurper. "Enjoyable" is a bit of a stretch. It is more that you are growing on me. Like Mould.
"Joy?" Is that what this is? I never realized I was such a masochist. Hm. Or is it simply the sensation of my body rotting away, and the feeling of you all "growing on me?"
It is somewhat enjoyable to have someone to talk to. Even if you lot are, as you said, grating from time to time.
Loneliness? Bah. The only thing you stave off is whatever sanity is attempting to return to my life. If you are attempting to imply that you lot are "growing on me" do you know what else does that?
Paint my kind in crimson all you wish. Melt Orokin gold and call us monsters. We deserve every ounce of vitriol you can spare for us.
I will admit you are... growing on me. Like mould.
But do not dare believe for one second that it was all we were capable of.
If you wish to exterminate all Orokin? Walk up the stairs. You have a few surviving examples who cannot escape your wrath. Start with "Grandmother."
There is another reason why I have not gone on some mad, bloodlust-driven, hideous rampage, Usurper.
She has seen the most of our ilk, after all.
I have yet to see the conclusion of the little drama between our dear butler and Albrecht's estranged family upstairs.
I have a personal investment in all this, don't forget, whether or not we have an arrangement. I plan to make sure that when Albrecht first steps foot back in this Sanctum, the first face he sees?
I simply cannot yet make up my mind if I will be surrounded by the corpses of his loved ones or not when he does.
